reuse.why: Extends the existing shared pre-link guard that every provider link function already calls; the inline SELECT could have used db.getAccount but that is minor.

duplication.why: The closed-account check is written once in the shared guard; no per-provider copies.

placement.why: The rule sits in the pre-link validation helper in accounts/app.ts, right where the existing linking precondition lives, before any mutation.

scope.why: Focused on the rule plus tests; the helper rename touches six call sites but only to reflect its widened purpose.

maintainability.why: A single named guard holds all link preconditions, so future providers inherit the rule automatically.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the shared assertBankAccountNotLinkedElsewhere guard (renamed assertCanLinkBankAccount); minor raw SELECT instead of db.getAccount is not a bypass of a layer.

one_place.where: assertCanLinkBankAccount in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by all six provider link functions (the only upgradingId paths).
